hook: Triconnected percolation clusters have fractal dimension 1.2308 in 2D, falling to zero by 6D.
summary: A new algorithm based on SPQR decomposition finds clusters that stay connected after removing any two sites, and Monte Carlo runs estimate their fractal dimension in 2, 3 and 4 dimensions. The dimension drops with dimension and vanishes at 6 and above, so the susceptibility stays finite for d of 3 or more. The values come from finite-size simulations, and the d=6 conclusion rests on logarithmic growth.
title: Critical geometry of triconnected clusters in percolation
